items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: What about Friday Ford, you ever hear of him? Uh-uh.

ctx.x: Not, not Red Toots. Oh. Red Caillou. Red Caillou. I don't know if you ever heard, he may have left town, he left a long time ago, I never met him. What about Friday Ford, you ever hear of him? Uh-uh. Little Willie Forrest?
